name: resolve
description: Asks Resolve before any Figma screen or coded HTML prototype is built, and uses only real components. One engine, two workflows: Figma and code.

FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Figma token
FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: A Figma personal access token for your library, for example the Acme design system. Claude Code stores it. Do not paste it into a project file.

RESOLVE_LIBRARY_FILE_KEY.title: Library file key
RESOLVE_LIBRARY_FILE_KEY.description: The id in the Figma link for the design system. In https://www.figma.com/design/ACMEUI/Acme the key is ACMEUI.

RESOLVE_MODE.title: Workflow mode
RESOLVE_MODE.description: figma, code, or both. Leave empty to infer: both when a repo path is set, else figma.

RESOLVE_REPO_PATH.title: Code repo folder
RESOLVE_REPO_PATH.description: Code workflow. The folder with the design system CSS and HTML screens. Leave empty for Figma only.

RESOLVE_CSS_ENTRY.title: Entry stylesheet
RESOLVE_CSS_ENTRY.description: Code workflow. Entry CSS inside the repo, for example acme-ds/css/acme.css. Optional.

RESOLVE_THEME.title: Theme file
RESOLVE_THEME.description: Code workflow. Theme token file inside the repo, for example theme/tokens.css. Optional.
